messages:
Rohan Desai: heads up - Azura Labs renewal invoice INV-2026-980 shows platform fee at $14k (should be $7k) and support at "Premier". Signed amendment says Support=Standard and platform fee unchanged.

Meghan (Acct Ops): can you paste sub id? I'll grab the invoice lines.

Rohan Desai: sub AZR-PRV-12. invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-980
Subscription: AZR-PRV-12
Private Deployment (reserved capacity) - $40,000/year
Platform Fee - $14,000/year
Support - Premier - $7,000/year
Total Due: $61,000
```
Signed amendment on 2026-02-02 in CRM (AZR-210) shows platform fee $7,000 and Support Standard $3,500.

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-980 generated at 2026-06-28T08:45:12Z by billing-service.

Meghan (Acct Ops): quick check - meter shows a one-off reserve_pool event on 2026-03-18 that billed as a true-up +7k platform fee. Sales note indicates trial was approved to be waived. Also catalog mapping defaulted to Premier on renewal.

Jules (Sales): confirmed I approved the trial pools to be waived (email 2026-03-19). Amendment downgrades support to Standard. I'll forward my approval email and attach amendment.

Meghan (Acct Ops): proposed fix: credit platform true-up $7,000 and change support line to Standard ($3,500) by issuing a $3,500 correction credit. Reissue invoice showing line-by-line credits and attach docs. Finance approval needed?

Rohan Desai: combined credit $10,500. Finance can approve up to $25k for contract remediation. Proceed.

Billing Bot: credit CR-2026-601 created for INV-2026-980 amount $10,500. Reissued invoice INV-2026-980-R. Memo: "Waive trial reserve pools per sales approval; correct support tier to Standard per signed amendment."

Meghan (Acct Ops): credits applied and docs attached. I'll notify customer and RevRec. Closing thread.
